title: 重回认亲宴前夜
hook: 系统奖励的监控碎片揭开惊人关系：乔安然深夜进入林怀远书房，并喊他“爸”，暗示真假千金背后另有夺产阴谋。
summary: 大火吞没认亲宴后的林宅。林晚月被锁在杂物间，隔着火光听见乔安然轻笑：“真千金又怎样？林家很快就是我爸的了。”下一秒，房梁坠落。她猛地睁眼，眼中火光变成酒店水晶灯——手机日期显示，认亲宴前七天。淡金色字幕浮现：命运改写系统绑定，首个节点：林正廷签署致命合同，失败则林氏破产、父亲入狱。林晚月冲进会议室，正撞见父亲与二叔林怀远准备签约。她夺过合同，所有人震惊。乔安然红着眼上前：“姐姐，你是不是怕爸爸把钱分给我？”林正廷沉下脸，斥她胡闹。前世父亲戴着手铐的画面刺入脑海，林晚月强迫自己冷静，翻到骑缝章处，指出章印错位半毫米，附件页纸张批次不同。律师不耐烦，却被她逼着当场核验电子备案。几分钟后，结果弹出：核心担保附件被替换，金额多出三十亿。会议室死寂。林怀远笑意微僵，乔安然攥紧裙摆。林正廷第一次认真看向这个刚接回来的女儿。系统提示：节点改写成功，奖励监控碎片。画面里，深夜的林怀远书房门开，乔安然低声喊：“爸，林晚月已经开始怀疑了。”。本集按“铺垫、压迫、转折、爆发、余韵”推进：铺垫人物当下目标，压迫来自极寒环境和道德勒索，转折来自一个被忽略的细节，爆发不是喊叫而是主角做出反常选择，余韵落在新的危机。人物关系上，表层冲突是立场对抗，隐藏关系是双方都掌握对方不知道的信息，因此台词必须克制、短促、有潜台词。

shots.aiPromptEn: English prompt: vertical 9:16 cinematic AI drama with consistent character design, suitable for image-to-video and text-to-video production. Lin Wanyue is a young elegant woman in her early twenties, long black hair, pale face, sharp expressive eyes; her emotion evolves from terrified survivor to calm avenger. Open inside the burning Lin mansion after a recognition banquet: charred doorframe and twisted chains dominate the foreground, Lin Wanyue sits trapped in a storage room with soot and blood on her face, flames pouring through the door crack and window lattice. In the background, red banquet ribbons, a shattered champagne tower and a collapsed flower wall burn. Qiao Anran appears half-hidden beyond the fire in a pale dress, smiling softly, dropping a key into the flames. Use a low-angle close-up from Lin Wanyue’s trembling fingers to her firelit eyes, then rack focus through the door crack to Qiao Anran’s blurred smile; a falling beam shadow crushes the frame and cuts to black. Match cut to a hotel suite: fire reflections become warm white crystal chandelier light in her pupils. She wakes, checks her unburned neck and wrists, grabs the phone showing seven days before the banquet. Pale golden system text floats between her and the mirror: fate rewrite system bound, first node: Lin Zhengting signs a deadly contract, failure means Lin Group bankruptcy and father imprisoned. She suppresses fear, hardens her gaze, throws on a coat and runs out. Cut to the Lin hotel conference room: long table, executives and lawyers, cold business lighting. Lin Zhengting is about to sign, Lin Huaiyuan sits at his right with a controlled smile, Qiao Anran stands behind him pretending to be gentle and wronged. Extreme close-up of the pen tip on the signature line, then handheld tracking as Lin Wanyue bursts in against backlight, presses down the contract and snatches it away. Show tense reaction shots: father angry, Qiao Anran teary, Lin Huaiyuan’s smile stiffening. Final sequence: the contract lies open on the table, macro shots of a half-millimeter misaligned seam seal, different paper fibers on the attachment pages, electronic filing numbers loading on a projected screen. The lawyer turns pale as the pop-up reveals the core guarantee attachment was replaced and the guarantee amount increased by three billion. The room falls silent; Lin Zhengting looks at his daughter seriously for the first time, Lin Huaiyuan hides panic, Qiao Anran clenches her skirt until her knuckles whiten. A cold system notification announces success, then overlay a black-and-white surveillance fragment with timecode and static: late-night study door opening, Qiao Anran checks the corridor, enters the shadows and whispers to Lin Huaiyuan, calling him Dad. Emphasize realistic acting, micro-expressions, suspenseful pacing, layered spatial depth, shallow depth of field, orange-red fire contrast, warm hotel lighting, cold blue meeting-room tension, black-and-white noisy CCTV texture, with audible flames, breaking wood, glass bursts, phone vibration, air conditioner hum, paper rustle, mouse clicks and electronic static.

shots.sound: 水晶灯细微电流声、手机震动声、心跳低频逐渐加重；系统提示音干净冰冷，与她急促呼吸形成对比。她赤脚落地时地毯闷响，随后门被推开的声音干脆有力。
shots.emotion: 情绪与戏剧目的：完成重生与系统规则交代，让林晚月从惊恐迅速进入行动状态，明确本集目标是阻止父亲签约。
